generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery packet can look structurally valid while its active remediation source belongs to another work item, or while its published result commit is not the direct child of the material candidate certified by that packet.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Reuse whichever audit source and remediation files already exist, then publish a later result commit without checking semantic target identity and direct-parent lineage.
trigger_signals: pre-existing audit package is reused for a new delivery target
active remediation source identity differs from the requested work item
published result commit is separated from the frozen material candidate by intermediate commits
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Before publication, cross-check the active audit source and remediation ledger against the requested semantic target; after publication, require the result commit to have the frozen material candidate as its direct parent and reconcile the remote head again.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Never inherit active remediation identity from a previous target, and never publish the terminal result child before all material writes are complete.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail the handoff when repository/work-item/PR/rejection binding differs, or when the published result commit is not the direct child of the certified material candidate.

transfer_cases.scenario: A reusable delivery workspace still contains a closed remediation ledger for a different synthetic work item.
A result-only commit is published after an intermediate nonterminal commit instead of directly after the frozen synthetic material candidate.

skill_changes.evidence: The delivery target-binding contract already requires foreign reusable packets to be ignored and reconstructed for the current semantic target.
The terminal handoff guard already requires a fresh remote-head read, direct material parent equality and result-only changed-path enforcement.
